content: As proposed by BIBREF4 , an attention function maps a query and a set of key-value pairs to an output, where the queries INLINEFORM0 , keys INLINEFORM1 , and values INLINEFORM2 are all vectors. The input consists of queries and keys of dimension INLINEFORM3 , and values of dimension INLINEFORM4 . The attention function is given by: DISPLAYFORM0
